title: UNESCO honour puts China's ancient porcelain legacy in global spotlight
description: BEIJING: The ancient kilns of Jingdezhen in eastern China have transformed humble clay into exquisite porcelain for more than 2,000 years. The celebrated ceramics travelling across oceans, bridging cultures and fostering exchanges between civilisations.

title: Rumor of 'ancient watchtower in Xizang forcibly demolished' debunked
description: A video circulating online that allegedly shows the forcible demolition of an ancient Jiarong watchtower in Xizang has been dismissed as false by a Chinese media outlet. An investigation found that the footage was misleading and did not involve any protected cultural heritage site.

title: Kenyan Fossil Footprints Reveal Gender Divide Among 1.4-Million-Year-Old Human Relatives
description: Twenty-one fossil footprints from Kenya's Lake Turkana reveal that Paranthropus boisei moved in male-dominated groups 1.43 million years ago and was substantially larger than skeletal evidence had suggested, according to a new study in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.
